records.title: How to Train Your Long-Context Visual Document Model
records.reason: The visual-document model paper studies continued pretraining, fine-tuning, and preference optimization for long-context capability; its scope is training, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Prompt Engineering Accelerates the Data‐Driven Discovery of Photocatalysts via an LLM‐Based Model Ensemble Strategy
records.reason: The photocatalyst work uses an LLM ensemble for literature extraction and scientific discovery; its contribution is data extraction/application accuracy, not LLM efficiency.

records.title: Augmenting Small Language Model for Better Medical Question Answering through Source Authentication
records.reason: The abstract reports a resource-constrained 1.5B medical QA/RAG system and fewer resources than a 7B comparison, but the supplied ACM DOI primary full text could not be retrieved; whether the difference comes from model scale or a reusable inference method remains unverified.

records.title: Reliability of LLM Inference Engines from a Static Perspective: Root Cause Analysis and Repair Suggestion via Natural Language Reports
records.reason: The paper analyzes and repairs reliability defects in LLM inference engines; its goal is correctness/reliability rather than efficiency.

records.title: Jailbreaking Leaves a Trace: Understanding and Detecting Jailbreak Attacks from Internal Representations of Large Language Models
records.reason: The study detects jailbreak attacks from model representations and targets security accuracy, not inference efficiency.
